notes: Backlog, fixed-price exposure and equipment model are not in the evidence; the equipment and fixed-price values come from general knowledge of Granite.

infrastructure_project_type.value: Transportation (highways, bridges), water infrastructure, mineral exploration services, plus construction materials (aggregates, asphalt)

public_private_client_mix.value: Public and private clients across the Americas; largely public-agency transportation and water work, with some private customers

heavy_equipment_model.value: Largely self-performed work with owned construction fleet and vertically integrated owned quarries and asphalt plants

project_delivery_duration.value: Multi-year projects delivered through CM/GC and progressive design-build, in two phases: budget-level design, then final design and construction

concession_operating_commitments.value: Primarily build-focused contracts, including design-build and CM/GC; no concession operating commitments evident
